name: Adaptively Sampled Distance Fields
definition: A representation for vector outlines and 3D shapes using tree compression on signed distance fields, modified to preserve the sign of the approximated data to accurately encode the zero set (shape boundary).
summary: Adaptively Sampled Distance Fields compress 3D shapes by encoding signed distance fields in a tree structure that preserves topological accuracy through sign preservation, enabling high compression ratios and resolution-independent antialiasing.
